title: Solar occupancy codes
text:
Solar occupancy codes 

Solar occupancy codes supported in 
Touchstone 2025
 for
 the 
Verisk Severe Thunderstorm Model for the United States
.

Note:
 For information about supported codes and limitations for this model,
 refer to the model documentation that is available on the 
Client Portal
.

| Occupation code | Category | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3001 | Residential Solar Energy Risk | Residential assets |
| 3011 | Commercial Solar Energy Risk | Commercial assets |
| 3020 | Utility Solar Unknown | Utility-scale assets with capacity unknown |
| 3021 | Utility Solar Small Energy Risk | Utility-scale assets with capacity under 5 megawatts (MW) |
| 3022 | Utility Solar Medium Energy Risk | Utility-scale assets with capacity between 5 MW and 25 MW |
| 3023 | Utility Solar Large Energy Risk | Utility-scale assets with capacity above 25 MW |
